headline: Independent tests rank Mistral's new Large 4 model first outside the US and China, but behind several cheaper Chinese open models.
score_reason: Kept at 6: independent data on a major European model, but a preview with unreleased weights and mid-table results.
importance_line: It gives companies seeking a non-US, non-Chinese AI option an outside check on Mistral's claims, though the model is still a preview whose weights are not out and could be re-scored.
summary: Tom's Hardware reports, citing the testing firm Artificial Analysis, that Mistral Large 4, the French company's trillion-parameter model we covered on 7 Oct 2026, scored 38 on its intelligence index, the best from outside the two countries but below at least five Chinese open models, such as MiMo-V2.6-Pro at 46. It is also dearer to run, at about $1.13 per test task at list price against $0.25 for GLM-5.3-Flash, and Mistral promises its open weights only by the end of October.
notes: Launch about 6 Oct 2026; new today are the independent test results.
